drills.title: Where Does This One Go?
drills.description: You're Transport Officer. Central (Level I trauma, near, flooded with walk-ins), East (community, spare beds), Children's (pediatric, farther), Burn Center (40 min). Pick the best move.

items.prompt: Adult red, gunshot to the abdomen, weak radial pulse.
options: Hold on scene for IV fluids
items.why: Non-compressible torso hemorrhage needs a trauma surgeon.

items.prompt: 20 greens with bruises and small cuts.
options: Bus with a medic to East (spare capacity)
Hold until all reds are gone
items.why: Move greens in bulk, away from the flooded trauma center.

items.prompt: Yellow adult, closed tib fracture, stable.
items.why: Protect the trauma center's capacity for reds; East has beds.

items.prompt: Red 6-year-old, stable airway, splenic injury suspected, 15 min to Children's.
items.why: Pediatric-capable center when the time cost is acceptable.

items.prompt: Adult red with 40% burns and singed nasal hair, voice getting hoarse.
options: Central — closest capable airway/trauma care now
items.why: Threatened airway can't wait 40 min. Stabilize at the nearest capable center, transfer to burns later.

items.prompt: Red patient + space for passengers in the same ambulance.
options: Add 1–2 greens going to the same hospital
items.why: Fill seats sensibly: 1 red + 1–2 greens (per policy).

items.prompt: Patient contaminated with an unknown liquid chemical.
options: Decon first, then transport and notify hospital
Wrap in a blanket and load
items.why: Decon before transport — a contaminated ambulance is out of service and its crew become patients.

items.prompt: An ambulance crew wants to take 'their' patient to their usual hospital.
options: Transport Officer assigns destination per the plan
items.why: Destination is assigned centrally to balance load and capability.

items.prompt: Scene is 90 min by road from the only trauma center; red patient.
options: Air medical if available, LZ away from treatment area
items.why: Long distance + critical = air medical is worth the LZ cost.

items.prompt: You don't know how many beds East has.
options: Ask Med Comms/hospital coordination for capacity by color
